title: 《遗忘之海》公测首周总览：入口、福利、对比、清单一页看完
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Launch Week Overview: Access, Rewards, Comparison, and Checklist
summary: 把今天开服最重要的内容串起来：平台入口、首日清单、福利、首周路线和和《失控进化》的对比。
summaryEn: A single page that connects the most important launch-day items: access, day-one actions, rewards, weekly route, and the Ashfall comparison.
content:
## 今天先看什么

1. 先看今天新增的内容，确认 iOS 云试玩版和 PV《初航乐章》已经上线。
2. 先看平台入口，确认今天从 Steam 还是官方启动器进。
3. 先看开服 30 分钟清单，别把资源和 6 选 1 乱花掉。
4. 先看首月福利，把预约礼、邮件礼和 100 抽资源记清楚。
5. 先看首周每日清单，按天推进主线和系统。
6. 先看和《失控进化》的对比，决定谁是主游谁是副游。

## 一页速查

| 模块 | 推荐页面 | 你要记住的事 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 平台入口 | 平台入口速查 | 今天先上 PC，7 月 23 日移动端 |
| 首日操作 | 开服 30 分钟清单 | 先领福利，再推主线 |
| 福利奖励 | 公测福利与兑换码 | 100 抽、自选黑券、直播码 |
| 周期推进 | 首周每日清单 | 第 1 周别急着全清高难内容 |
| 游戏选择 | 今天先玩谁的对比页 | 风格党先《遗忘之海》，硬核党看《失控进化》 |

## 最后一个提醒

《遗忘之海》的强项不只是“今天开了”，而是“今天开了以后你知道怎么持续玩”。如果你只想看一个入口，先看平台页；如果你想直接开局，先看 30 分钟清单。
contentEn:
## What to Read First

1. Check the platform guide to decide whether you are starting on Steam or the official launcher.
2. Read the first 30 minutes checklist so you do not waste resources or lock the 6-choice selector too early.
3. Review launch rewards and codes so you remember the 100 pulls, reservation rewards, and livestream code.
4. Follow the first-week daily checklist so your story and systems progress stays on track.
5. Compare Sea of Remnants with Ashfall Evolution if you still want to decide which game is your main one.

## One-Page Summary

| add-onule | Best Page | What to Remember |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Access | Platform guide | PC today, mobile on July 23, 2026 |
| First actions | First 30 minutes checklist | Claim rewards before pushing story |
| Rewards | Launch rewards and codes | 100 pulls, Black Ticket, livestream code |
| Weekly pacing | First-week checklist | Do not rush every high-difficulty system |
| Game choice | Launch day comparison | Style-first players pick Sea; hardcore players may prefer Ashfall |

## Final Note

Sea of Remnants is not just about starting today. It is about knowing what to do after the first login. If you only read one page, start with the platform guide. If you want to play now, start with the first 30 minutes checklist.

faq.question: What should I open first today?
faq.answer: Open the platform guide first if you still need to download. If you already have the client, open the first 30 minutes checklist.
faq.answerZh: 如果你还要下载，先看平台入口页；如果客户端已经有了，就先看开服 30 分钟清单。

faq.question: Is this page enough to start playing?
faq.answer: Yes. This overview links the most important launch pages, so you can move from access to rewards to the weekly plan without hunting around.
faq.answerZh: 够。这一页把最重要的开服页面串起来了，你可以从入口、福利一路看到账期推进，不用来回找。
